questions.question: Who has been named the recipient of the 2025 United Nations Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award?

options.text: Commander Carla Monteiro de Castro Araujo

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Abhilasha Barak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian peacekeeper **Major Abhilasha Barak** has been named the recipient of the **2025 United Nations Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Abhilasha Barak** is being recognized for her outstanding outreach and community engagement activities for **women and adolescent girls** during her deployment in **Lebanon**.
 
• She is currently serving with the Indian Battalion as the Commander of the **Female Engagement Team (FET)** in the **UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL)**.
 
• The award also acknowledges her efforts in providing **gender sensitisation training** for peacekeepers.
 
• Barak holds the distinction of being the first **woman combat helicopter pilot** of the **Indian Army**.
 
• She will be officially honored at the **UN headquarters** on **May 29**, which is the **International Day of UN Peacekeepers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Major Abhilasha Barak is the **third Indian** to receive this prestigious award.
 
• **Major Suman Gawani** was the first Indian recipient, winning the **2019** award for her service with the **UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS)**.
 
• **Major Radhika Sen** received the **2023** award for her work with the **UN Organization Stabilisation Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO)**.
 
• Commander **Carla Monteiro de Castro Araujo** (a Brazilian Naval officer) was a co-recipient of the award in 2019 alongside Major Gawani.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The award highlights India's significant contribution to **UN Peacekeeping** and its commitment to **gender equality** in military operations.
 
• The recognition is tied to the **International Day of UN Peacekeepers**, observed annually on **May 29**.

questions.question: According to the recent achievement by **TractorGyan** and **Mahindra Farm Machinery**, how many crop bales were created within 24 hours to set a record in the **Golden Book of World Records**?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1571 bales**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **TractorGyan** and **Mahindra Farm Machinery** have secured two milestones in the **Golden Book of World Records** for their initiative in the agricultural sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The joint partnership achieved two specific records: **'Longest feat of operating Baler machine'** and **'Most Crop bales created by baler machine in 24 hours'**.
 
• During the record-breaking attempt, **1571 bales** were created within a 24-hour period using modern machinery.
 
• The record-breaking event was conducted across various agricultural farms in **Suryapet, Telangana**.
 
• The initiative aimed to demonstrate high-capacity solutions to eliminate **stubble burning** (parali) and manage agricultural waste effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Stubble burning** is a significant source of air pollution in India, releasing gases like **CO2, CH4, CO, and N2O**.
 
• The crop residue converted into bales serves as **raw material** for **power plants** and the **plywood industry**, providing farmers with an additional **revenue stream**.
 
• **TractorGyan** is a digital marketplace that provides information on tractor prices, models, loans, and insurance to the farming community.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The achievement aligns with the **Government of India’s** mandate to reach **"zero burn"** incidents through in-situ and ex-situ management.
 
• The use of **baler technology** helps improve the **Air Quality Index (AQI)** by offering a sustainable alternative to burning dry straw.
 
• The initiative was led by **Shivankur Gupta** (Founder & CEO) and **Ankur Gupta** (Co-founder & CMO) of TractorGyan.

questions.question: Which novel has won the **2026 International Booker Prize**, becoming the first book translated from **Mandarin Chinese** to receive this honor?

options.text: On Earth As It Is Beneath

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Taiwan Travelogue**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Taiwanese writer **Yáng Shuāng‑zǐ** and translator **Lin King** have been awarded the **2026 International Booker Prize** for the novel **Taiwan Travelogue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taiwan Travelogue** is the first book translated from **Mandarin Chinese** to win the International Booker Prize in its history.
 
• The author, **Yáng Shuāng‑zǐ**, is the first **Taiwanese** winner of the prize, which is currently celebrating its **10th anniversary**.
 
• The novel is set in **1930s Japanese-occupied Taiwan** and follows the story of a Japanese novelist, **Aoyama Chizuko**, and her Taiwanese translator, **Ō Chizuru**.
 
• The prize is valued at **£50,000** (approximately $93,000 Cdn), which is split evenly between the **winning author** and the **winning translator**.
 
• The other options like **Heart Lamp** was the previous year's winner (by Indian author **Banu Mushtaq**), while **On Earth As It Is Beneath** was a shortlisted finalist in the same year. **The Boy from Clearwater** is a graphic novel series translated by Lin King but did not win this prize.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The theme for the **2026 International Booker Prize** was **"fiction beyond borders."**
 
• The award ceremony was held at **London's Tate Modern**, with the announcement made by British author **Natasha Brown**, who chaired the five-member voting panel.
 
• In addition to this prize, **Taiwan Travelogue** also won the **National Book Award for Literature in Translation** in 2024 and Asia Society’s inaugural **Baifang Schell Book Prize**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Yáng Shuāng-zǐ** is a versatile writer whose work spans fiction, essays, manga, and video game scripts.
 
• **Lin King** is a Taiwanese and American writer/translator based in **Taipei** and **New York**, and her debut novel **Weeb** is forthcoming.
 
• Last year's winner, **Banu Mushtaq**, was the second **Indian author** to win after **Geetanjali Shree** in 2022.

questions.question: From which Scandinavian country did Prime Minister Narendra Modi receive the Grand Cross of the Royal Order of Merit, marking his 32nd global honour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Norway.**__

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi was awarded the Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit during his maiden visit to Norway.
 
• This marked the first visit by an Indian Prime Minister to Norway in 43 years.
 
• The prestigious award constitutes PM Modi's 32nd global honour and was presented by King Harald V in Oslo.
 
• The Grand Cross was awarded for his contributions to advancing Norway's interests and strengthening international relations, an honour he dedicated to historic India-Norway ties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Grand Cross of Royal Norwegian Order of Merit__

 __
 
• Founded by King Olav V in 1985.
 
• Awarded to foreign nationals and Norwegian citizens living abroad for outstanding service in the interests of Norway.
 
 
 
• King Harald V__
 
 
• The current King of Norway, having ascended the throne on 17 January 1991.
 
• Serves as the ceremonial head of state.

• **Parveen Shaikh** has been honoured with the prestigious **Whitley Award** for her remarkable efforts in the conservation of the **Indian Skimmer**.

__
 
• **Parveen Shaikh** won the **Whitley Award** for her dedicated work on **Indian Skimmer** conservation.

questions.question: Which state was identified as an 'Exemplar' among the Coastal States in the LEADS 2025 report released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister of Commerce and Industry **Shri Piyush Goyal** felicitated the winners of **LEAPS Awards 2025** and released the **LEADS Report 2025** in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **LEADS 2025 report**, **Tamil Nadu** was identified as an **Exemplar** among the **Coastal States**.
 
• The **Exemplars** category represents the top-performing States and Union Territories that demonstrate sustained excellence across policy, infrastructure, service delivery, and regulatory dimensions.
 
• **Gujarat** was categorized as a **High Performer** among Coastal States.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** was categorized as an **Accelerator** among Coastal States.
 
• **West Bengal** was categorized as a **Growth-Seeker** among Coastal States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **LEADS (Logistics Ease Across Different States) 2025** framework transitioned from its previous three-tier classification to a comprehensive **four-tier performance framework**: Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators, and Growth-Seekers.
 
• Other states designated in the **Exemplar** category include **Uttar Pradesh** (Landlocked States), **Mizoram** (North-Eastern States), and **Delhi** (Union Territories).
 
• At the event, the Union Minister highlighted that India achieved an all-time high export figure of **USD 863 billion** for the financial year ending March 31, 2026, despite global challenges, and set a target of **USD 1 trillion** for the current year.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **LEAPS** stands for Logistics Excellence, Advancement and Performance Shield, organized by **DPIIT** to recognize organizations demonstrating leadership and innovation in logistics.
 
• **LEADS** is DPIIT’s flagship assessment tool supporting cooperative and competitive federalism by enabling States and UTs to benchmark their logistics performance.

questions.question: Who has been conferred with the Honorary Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) in March 2026 for strengthening India-UK business ties?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri N. Chandrasekaran.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Natarajan Chandrasekaran, Chairman of Tata Sons, was officially conferred with an honorary knighthood (KBE) by the British Sovereign.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Honor:** He received **"The Most Excellent Order of the British Empire (Civil Division)"** as a Knight Commander (KBE).
 
• **Reason:** Recognized for his contributions to strengthening bilateral business, trade, and economic ties between the UK and India.
 
• **Tata Group's UK Role:** Under his leadership, Tata has made massive investments in the UK in green steel, battery gigafactories, and Jaguar Land Rover.
 
• **Presentation:** The honor was presented at the British High Commissioner’s residence in New Delhi.
 
• **Legacy:** He joins previous Indian recipients like Ratan Tata (2009) and Jamshed Irani (1997).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **What is a KBE?__**

__
 
• British Honours System__

 
 
• The Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) is one of the highest ranking honours. While British citizens use the title 'Sir', non-British recipients receive it as an 'Honorary' award and can use the post-nominal letters 'KBE' after their name.

questions.question: Which Indian film made history by becoming the first to win the BAFTA for Best Children's & Family Film?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Boong**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Boong** is a Manipuri-language Indian film backed by Excel Entertainment.
 
• It made historic strides by becoming the first Indian film ever to win the BAFTA in the Best Children's & Family Film category.

**Comprehensive BAFTA 2026 Awards Reference__**

 
• **Major Awards & Acting Honors**

 
 
• **Best Film & Best Director:** **Paul Thomas Anderson** for ***One Battle After Another***.
 
• **Outstanding British Film:** ***Hamnet*** (Produced by Chloé Zhao, Liza Marshall, et al.).
 
• **Best Leading Actor:** **Robert Aramayo** (*I Swear*). He made history by also winning the public-voted **EE Rising Star Award** in the same year.
 
• **Best Leading Actress:** **Jessie Buckley** (*Hamnet*).
 
• **Best Supporting Actor:** **Sean Penn** (*One Battle After Another*).
 
• **Best Supporting Actress:** **Wunmi Mosaku** (*Sinners*).
 
 
 
• **Screenplay & Genre Awards**
 
 
• **Best Original Screenplay:** **Ryan Coogler** for ***Sinners***.
 
• **Best Adapted Screenplay:** **Paul Thomas Anderson** for ***One Battle After Another***.
 
• **Best Children's & Family Film:** ***Boong***. Backed by Excel Entertainment, this Manipuri-language film made history as the **first Indian film** to win a BAFTA in this category.
 
• **Best Animated Film:** ***Zootopia 2***.
 
• **Best Film Not in the English Language:** ***Sentimental Value***.
 
• **Best Documentary:** ***Mr Nobody Against Putin***.
 
 
 
• **Technical & Special Honors**
 
 
• **Technical Sweeps:** ***Frankenstein*** won three awards for **Production Design**, **Costume Design**, and **Make Up & Hair**.
 
• **Best Original Score:** **Ludwig Göransson** for ***Sinners*** (Ryan Coogler accepted the award on his behalf, joking he was busy with "a small independent film called *The Odyssey*").
 
• **Best Sound:** ***F1***.
 
• **Best Special Visual Effects:** ***Avatar: Fire and Ash***.
 
• **BAFTA Fellowship:** **Donna Langley**.
 
• **Outstanding British Contribution to Cinema:** **Clare Binns**.
 
 
 
• **Historic Milestones**
 
 
• ***One Battle After Another*** set a BAFTA record for the **most nominations (14)** and led the night with **6 wins**.
 
• ***Hamnet*** became the **most-nominated film by a female director** (Chloé Zhao) in BAFTA history with 11 nominations.
 
• ***Sinners*** became the **most-nominated and most-awarded film by a Black director** (Ryan Coogler), earning 13 nominations and 3 wins.
 
• ***Marty Supreme*** tied the record for the **most losses** at a single ceremony, going 0-for-11.
